sources.title: Addax Data Science - Customised coding solutions for ecologists
sources.snippet: Addax offers customised coding solutions for more efficient data analysis and intelligent workflow automation. For ecologists and nature conservationists. Addax Data Science helps you achieve reliable, data-driven insights, from AI species recognition models to statistics and visualisation. Do your data fall outside the ecological sector?

sources.title: AddaxAI - Turn wildlife imagery into ecological data - Addax Data Science
sources.snippet: AddaxAI identifies the animals in your camera-trap photos and videos. It takes care of the tedious part, so you can focus on the science.
